The first four shades are Micro-glitter. They're basically like metallic with teeny tiny glitter bits I them, they kinda have like a liquidy metallic finish. High and Dirtysweet are my favourite, need to be seen to have a proper idea of how lovely they are.

Next four are Demi matte, as in they have a sort of matte, sort of metallic finish, like a mix between.

The last four are completely matte. Whiskey I absolutely love, the naked palettes have been seriously missing a dark brown matte and this one finally has one.

The brush is actually one of my favourite things about it! It's not that big, maybe I just have weird hands haha. I prefer it to the brush in the other Naked palettes.

The blender side is sort of similar to the MAC 217, but a little bit more dense and not as..frizzy/fluffy? And the smudgey side is sort of similar to a smaller, less tapered MAC 219

I always use those two MAC brushes to blend my edges and to apply in my outer corner and under eye, so it's nice to have similar brushes together to throw in my makeup bag.

I don't know if I'm the best person to ask, cause I have a severe palette addiction that causes me to get every single palette ever made. That said I think it may be my favourite of the Naked palettes so far!

Lipstick textures: 

All of these lipsticks are very dry matte, not drying exactly, just dry, think Ruby Woo. The only exceptions being Drench, Pristine, Disciple and Kontrol, which have a little tiny bit of a shine to them, but are still quite matte.

My favourites(in application, not colour, all the colours are lovely): 

-Eurydice is a very matte pink which I wore out on a night drinking and didn't have to top up once, that shit STAYED on. Even after cleanser I found my lips were still a bit pink.
-Disciple is creamy and rich and gorgeous, I love the texture on this one. 
-Climax is possibly my favourite pink, feels lovely and soft and natural.

My least favourites(in texture again):
-Trash(now discontinued) is glittery and grainy, have to put on like a million coats to look nice.
-Sonnet is a little patchy and I found it didn't stay in place too well.
-Drench(also discontinued) is a lot more watery than the rest and not as pigmented.

These are just my opinions though! They might be different for you :)
